en: Black‑and‑white view down a gently curving pedestrian path between several modernist mid‑rise residential or dormitory blocks. The buildings are rectangular with flat roofs and repetitive window rows; one has a distinctive grid of small square windows. A few people walk along the path, and open fields or hills are visible in the distant background. The image has the look of a mid‑20th‑century campus or housing estate. Faint printed text from a library watermark is visible across the center.
